statBlock.name: Merfolk Skirmisher
statBlock.description: A merfolk defender who guards its settlement against aquatic predators and raiders from the surface.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merfolk breathes air and water.
sections.Actions: Ocean Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage. If the target is a creature, reduce its Speed by 10 ft. through the end of its next turn. After a ranged attack, the spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately.

statBlock.name: Merfolk Wavebender
statBlock.description: A merfolk mage who calls on currents, storms, and sea creatures.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merfolk breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Aquatic Burst attacks.
Aquatic Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) cold damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Wisdom (save DC 15). Omit material components.
At will. Elementalism, Light.
1/day each. Control Water, Create or Destroy Water.
sections.Reactions: Watery Rebuke. When an enemy the merfolk can see enters a space within 5 ft. of it, the enemy makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) cold damage. If it is Large or smaller and fails the save, a rush of conjured water pushes it up to 30 ft. directly away from the merfolk.

statBlock.name: Sahuagin Warrior
statBlock.description: A sea devil raider who hunts with sharks and keeps fighting once its claws draw blood.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. Attack rolls against creatures below their maximum HP have Advantage.
Limited Amphibiousness. The sahuagin breathes air and water. It must submerge at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating out of water.
Shark Telepathy. The sahuagin uses magical telepathy to control sharks within 120 ft. of itself.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Aquatic Charge. Swim in a straight line toward a visible enemy, up to the sahuagin's Swim Speed.

statBlock.name: Ogrillon Ogre
statBlock.description: A curse changes a Humanoid into an ogre-like giant over 8 feet tall. The ogrillon retains features of its former self and feels a constant, supernatural anger.

sections.Actions:
Battleaxe. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, desert, forest, grassland, hill, mountain, swamp, Underdark.

statBlock.name: Grick Ancient
statBlock.description: A grick that has grown to immense size over centuries. It seeks out prey and may eat smaller gricks.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack, one Slam attack, and one Tentacles attack.
Beak. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Tentacles. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, all four tentacles Grapple it (escape DC 14).

statBlock.name: Lacedon Ghoul
statBlock.description: A loose-skinned ghoul that hunts in water. Some lacedons rise from drowned pirates or castaways who starved.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Icy Bite attacks.
Icy Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) cold damage and reduces the target's Speed by 5 ft. until the start of the ghoul's next turn.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. An affected creature makes a DC 10 Constitution save unless it is Undead or an elf. On a failed save, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Watery Rush. While underwater, move up to half the ghoul's Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

statBlock.name: Yuan-ti Infiltrator
statBlock.description: A yuan-ti spy whose scales or forked tongue can pass unnoticed. Infiltrators gain access to rivals so other yuan-ti can act on what they learn.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Poison Ray. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Wisdom (save DC 12). Omit material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
2/day. Suggestion.
